description: This file defines a controller class for managing the 'Total' extension in the admin panel of an OpenCart project. It includes methods for rendering the extension configuration page and saving configuration settings.

classes.name: Total
classes.description: Controller class for the Total extension in OpenCart's admin panel, managing the display and saving of configuration settings.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Renders the total extension configuration page with breadcrumbs, header, footer, and loaded view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the configuration settings for the total extension, with permission checks and JSON response.
